name: Kokuu Hyouryuu Nirgends
source:
Kokuu Hyouryuu Nirgends tells the story of a young man named Dünn Bit, who was just recruited for a special military unit called "Windmühle". Led by the young and pretty captain Eis Schwarz, this unit specializes in unique airplanes that can transform into giant combat robots called "Divers". They have recently began operation in the country of Vidar, where enemy activity has been spotted. Dünn has to prove himself as a capable pilot and fighter, and perhaps also to make impression on the gorgeous captain or other people in his team, most of which are pretty girls...

The game is a mixture of Japanese-style adventure and airplane combat simulation (with the addition of giant robot fights). The adventure parts follow a standard procedure: navigating an overview map of a location, and choosing menu commands ("Look", "Talk", "Think", etc. to interact). The combat is a simulation of a plane from the pilot's point of view, which includes managing fuel and ammunition, positioning the plane, tracking enemies on the radar, customizing plane parts, etc. Transformation into a diver can be done at any time during battles, and has its own advantages and disadvantages.

[From [url=http://www.play-asia.com/paOS-13-71-9u-49-zh-70-2jd1.html]play-asia.com[/url]]
translation:
《虚空漂流Nirgends》讲述青年迪恩·比特的故事。他刚刚获选加入名为“风车”的特种部队。这支部队由年轻貌美的艾丝·施瓦茨上尉率领，专门驾驶一种能够变形成巨型战斗机器人的特殊飞机；这种机器人被称为“潜行者”。部队近日开始在维达尔境内执行任务，因为当地发现了敌军活动的踪迹。迪恩必须证明自己是一名合格的飞行员与战士，或许还可以借机给迷人的上尉——又或部队里其他大多年轻貌美的成员——留下深刻印象……

游戏融合了日式冒险、空战模拟与巨型机器人战斗。冒险部分沿用传统模式：玩家在地点总览图上移动，再选择“观察”“交谈”“思考”等菜单指令与环境互动。战斗则从飞行员的第一视角模拟飞机驾驶，玩家需要管理燃油与弹药、调整飞机位置、通过雷达追踪敌人、改装飞机部件等。战斗中随时可以变形成“潜行者”，而两种形态各有利弊。

[引自[url=http://www.play-asia.com/paOS-13-71-9u-49-zh-70-2jd1.html]play-asia.com[/url]]
